عبد الرحمن بن عبد الله بن كعب بن مالك
عبد الله بن كعب بن مالك

notes: Two routes to the same story: the first has Abd al-Rahman quoting Ka'b directly; the second has Abd al-Rahman, then Abdullah b. Ka'b («أن عبد الله بن كعب بن مالك قال سمعت») before Ka'b. The texts differ, so the routes are separate groups with no shared tail
«- ثم اتفقا -» and similar are not names; the taḥwīl «ح» falls inside the story before the second route begins
Occurrence numbers count every place the same words stand, including inside the longer names
